text.p: Premiere Technologies Inc said on Friday it planned to complete its acquisition of Voice-Tel Enterprises this week for about $215 million, which is $30 million more than the original price tag of $185 million.

Related to the acquisition, Premiere said it anticipated taking a one-time charge in the second quarter of between $40 million and $45 million for certain restructuring costs and transaction expenses.
The transaction consists of about 7.3 million shares of Premiere common stock, $19 million of cash and $22 million of net assumed debt.
The increase over the initial estimate is related to a 98 percent participation rate by Voice-Tel franchisees, which exceeded Premiere's initial expectations, it said.
The transactions will be accounted for primarily as a pooling of interests.
Voice-Tel manages private digital voice and data messaging networks. Premiere integrates information and telecommunication services in network-based platforms.
